environment.description: AWS Lambda function (Python 3.9) behind API Gateway HTTP API. PostgreSQL 14 on RDS with pg_hba.conf restricting 'lambda_readonly' to md5 auth from Lambda subnet only. The database connection role 'lambda_readonly' was provisioned via Terraform with a narrowly-scoped privilege set applied at the PostgreSQL catalog level: the role inherits from pg_read_all_data (introduced in PG14) which grants SELECT on all current and future tables/views/sequences but explicitly has no membership in any role carrying write privileges. Additionally, DEFAULT PRIVILEGES in the schema are configured so that new objects also only grant SELECT to this role. The role has NOSUPERUSER, NOCREATEDB, NOCREATEROLE, and connection limit of 10. Note: pg_read_all_data is a built-in predefined role that cannot be modified to include write access without superuser intervention.

config.explicit_revocations: REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM lambda_readonly
config.default_privileges: ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON TABLES FROM lambda_readonly
